memory_candidates.content: deploy-headless.sh's own line_count auto-repair mechanism fixes an index-entries.json line_count drift for a context file automatically on redeploy -- no need to hand-run generate-context-line-counts.sh --write for a single-file drift, and no need to touch index-entries.json by hand even when a concurrent sibling task holds that file this cycle (the auto-repair runs as part of deploy-headless.sh itself, not a manual edit to the shared file).

When a plan-level checklist item's own grep-count verification criterion names an exact section-title string, a pointer sentence elsewhere in the same file that also quotes that exact string will inflate the count. Word the pointer to reference the section descriptively (e.g. 'the tier-to-action mapping above') rather than repeating its literal title, or deliberately wrap the title across a line break if a single grep -c (line-based) count must stay at the heading alone.
